description: This is the source code for the jQuery Cookie Plugin version 1.4.0, which provides functions for handling cookies (setting, reading, and deleting) in a web browser environment.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string for cookie value, respecting raw configuration.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a string from cookie value, respecting raw configuration.

methods.name: stringifyCookieValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a string suitable for cookie storage, JSON stringifying if configured.

methods.name: parseCookieValue
methods.description: Parses a cookie string value, handling quoted cookies and JSON decoding if enabled.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and converts a cookie value, applying a converter function if provided.
